label: Socket
description: A WebSocket endpoint: each connection opened at its path starts one run, and every message the caller sends is one item of `inbound`, so a Loop over it runs once per message. The opening request comes out on the fixed ports. Answer with Reply per message and Close at the end.

inputs.name: path
inputs.label: Path
inputs.description: Path under the project's live URL: literal segments and `{name}` captures (`chat/{room}`), or empty for the root address. No leading '/'.

inputs.name: dataType
inputs.label: Message shape
inputs.description: What each message is, both ways: `json` (`inbound: Generator[JsonDict]`, or `Generator[Image]` to store a `data:` URL or base64 message), `text` (`Generator[String]`), `bytes` (each binary frame stored, `Generator[File]`).

inputs.name: auth
inputs.description: Auth access node (ApiKeyAuth, JwtAuth, HmacAuth), checked on the opening request. Unwired, anyone with the URL may connect. The identity comes out on `caller`.

inputs.name: maxSessionSecs
inputs.label: Give up on one connection after this long
inputs.description: Hard ceiling on one session, no default: it cuts a live session on the clock. Departures are already caught by the protocol's ping; set it only to cap session length.

inputs.name: callerSilenceSecs
inputs.label: Call the caller gone after this much silence
inputs.description: Seconds the caller's machine may leave sent data unacknowledged before the caller counts as gone. Bounds silence, not session length. Raise for clients whose link sleeps. `0` uses the OS default (about fifteen minutes).

inputs.name: maxInboundMb
inputs.label: Largest message, in MB
inputs.description: Largest single message in MB; a bigger one ends the session with an error.

inputs.name: journalEphemeral
inputs.label: Keep the conversation out of the journal
inputs.description: On: the journal keeps only sizes and counts, never message content. Off (default): every message both ways is recorded (batched per second, trimmed above 100 KB; raw bytes never recorded).

outputs.name: fired
outputs.description: Always true when a caller connects.

outputs.name: path
outputs.description: Path as called, no leading slash.

outputs.name: caller
outputs.description: What the auth gate established: JWT claims, `{"key": <index>}` for an API key, `{}` for HMAC. Null with no `auth`.

outputs.name: inbound
outputs.description: One item per caller message, in order; ends when the caller disconnects. Declare the item type to match `dataType`. A second reader needs a custom node using the ctx (inbound is broadcast there).

then.message: Socket '{id}' path starts with '/'. The gateway prefixes the route automatically; drop the leading slash.

Socket '{id}' starts a run that never answers its caller: no node that answers it (a Reply, a Stream, a Close) is in it. Wire the answering node so the run reaches it (through data, or `_should_flow` on the node or on the group it sits in).

Socket '{id}' would exist once per instance, because {per_instance_reason}, but its public address is one for every instance. Keep the socket shared and pick the instance per call: the `Weft-Instance` header on a socket gated by a connection, or an instance token.
